scope: Balanced standard original2017 base/core, standard Blight Cards, solo and applicable current official FAQ corrections; individual component instructions explicitly delegated.

claims: Standard original base game on balanced boards, one to four Spirits; normal Blight Cards and one-Spirit solo are included.
Individual Spirit/card instructions remain expressly delegated; adversaries, scenarios, thematic maps, optional difficulty/scoring and expansion content are excluded.
CORE p32 expressly directs card clarifications and rules questions to the Living FAQ; applicable current general corrections apply even where first formal publication was in a later rulebook.
source_refs: CORE pp3,6,13,22,23,32; CORE p32 directly inspected

claims: Component counts agree with CORE pp4-5.
Explorer/Town/City Health and Ravage Damage are 1/2/3; destruction Fear is 0/1/2.
Dahan Health and counterattack Damage are 2; Invaders and Dahan are not limited by physical supply; Presence has 13 disks per color.
No normal piece stacking limit; at most one Sacred Site per Spirit in a land.

checked_claims.area: Balanced board setup and physical layouts
claims: Random one balanced board per Spirit; printed setup icons populated.
Two-board bottom-to-bottom layout with opposite corner Oceans, triangular three-board layout, and four-board two-row parallelogram match printed diagrams.
Setup Blight comes from box and does not destroy Presence or cascade.
source_refs: CORE pp6-7 directly inspected; CORE p15

claims: Fear Cards shuffled before selecting nine unseen cards, three at each Terror Level with dividers appropriately placed.
Four Fear markers per Spirit; start Terror I.
Each Invader stage shuffled separately with one unseen card removed: 3 Stage I, 4 Stage II, 5 Stage III, in that order.
Separate shuffled Minor and Major decks and shared deck discards.
source_refs: CORE p6 and p7 setup diagram directly inspected

claims: Healthy card randomly selected without inspecting reverse.
Normal setup pool is 2 per Spirit plus exactly 1 total; introductory no-card setup pool is 5 per Spirit plus exactly 1 total.
The extra one is never added again on a flip.
Different Spirit/color and starting board; four Unique cards start in hand.
Remaining Presence on dashed track spaces; starting solid spaces uncovered.
Equally satisfying setup choices are free, and separate placement instructions may select same land.
Initial Explore is last setup step and card then goes to Build; Ravage starts empty; first turn starts Spirit Phase.
Four named low-complexity original Spirits and their optional beginner progressions.
Progression substitutes next listed card for draw-four/keep-one; Major still requires Forgetting.
No-card variant is expressly separate from normal Blight Card play.
Simultaneous play permits waiting for another Spirit’s Growth result, but each Spirit follows Growth, Energy, play/pay in order.
All Spirits finish entire Spirit Phase before any Fast Power resolves.
Power user makes Power choices; other decisions seek consensus, then starting-board Spirit for lands or game owner/organizer otherwise.
Choose boxed option unless panel says otherwise; do all possible instructions in chosen order.
Incomplete instructions do not bar selecting an option; explicit selection costs must be paid in full.
Multiple Green Growth choices may interleave instructions.
Take leftmost track disk from either track; range measured from existing Presence.
Sequential placements may chain from newly added Presence.
May reposition existing island Presence even with track disks available, selecting destination before choosing disk, including measuring from the disk later taken.
Repositioning remains Add, not Move; destroyed Presence requires explicit permission.
Curved-arrow movement measures from current position.
Push/Gather uses adjacency and is mandatory to extent possible; a move up to a Range can be zero.

checked_claims.area: Energy, Card Plays and track benefits
claims: Highest uncovered numbered track value applies, values do not sum.
Energy persists and is individual; Card Plays cannot be shared or saved.
Reclaim takes personal discard, not play/forgotten cards; Reclaim One is once per Spirit Phase at any point including newly revealed turn.
Track Element spaces add continuously; flexible track Element can be chosen later but once selected cannot change that turn; flexible action-granted Elements chosen immediately.
Cards played from hand up to normal play limit, printed Energy paid during Spirit Phase including Slow cards.
Elements gained immediately; effects/targets need not resolve or be chosen yet.
Expected Fast Energy cannot pay previous Spirit-phase play costs.
Fast and eligible Innate Powers resolve in chosen order; do not interrupt other Powers.
May forego entire Power while retaining played card Elements, without refund.
Fast use cannot be saved for Slow; speed-converted Slow Power does not also activate again in Slow.
Slow targets chosen from current board when used.
Blighted Island instructions at printed timing, then Fear, Ravage, Build, Explore, advance cards.
Empty card space does nothing; Stage III affects both terrains with arbitrary land order; Coastal card affects Coastal lands.
No Adversary means ignore Stage II escalation symbols.
Need to draw with empty Invader deck loses; merely revealing last card does not.
Affected lands determined before resolving actions from card; subsequent movement/additions do not add a newly eligible land.
New Invaders do participate when entering a land already scheduled to Ravage.
Resolve each land and triggered actions before next; outcome checked per action tree.
Sum outgoing 1/2/3 Damage, apply Defend/modifiers, then equal separate simultaneous Damage to land and Dahan.
Existing damage does not reduce outgoing damage.
Two or more land Damage adds only one Blight; one Damage is not retained.
Dahan damage must be allocated to destroy efficiently; marked damage destroys on reaching Health.
Surviving Dahan counterattack for 2 each even if damaged or Invader Damage reduced to zero, but not if Ravage skipped.
Dahan do not shield land; Presence never counterattacks.
Early Dahan damage replaces normal counterattack; each Dahan damages once.
Earth Sacred Site loss during Ravage does not retroactively remove Defend from simultaneous Damage to Dahan.
Ravage example Town+Explorer+two Dahan correctly gives one Blight, one Dahan dead, survivor damaged and able to destroy Town for Fear.
Matching populated land Builds exactly one building: City if more Towns than Cities, otherwise Town; no upgrades.
Explore adds one supply Explorer in matching land with/adjacent to Town/City or adjacent to Ocean, independent of existing piece count.
Explorers are not sources; multiple sources do not multiply Explorers.
Skipped action in source land does not prevent it sourcing Explore elsewhere.
Played cards to personal discard; Damage clears; temporary Elements/effects expire and reminder markers removed.
Unspent Energy and permanent board changes remain; uncovered track Elements remain.
Innates normally cost no Energy/Card Play, need threshold Elements.
Elements are checked, not spent, can satisfy multiple thresholds, and card Elements persist only while card is in play.
Single target for all levels; no second activation merely from twice Elements.
Range is maximum land distance from own Presence with printed source restrictions.
Range 0, Sacred Site, origin terrain and target terrain/content restrictions are distinguished.
Slash icons mean union/either or both, not allowance per type.
Legal useless targets permitted, but foregone Power does not count as used/targeted.
Resolve printed instructions in order doing as much as possible; cannot arbitrarily omit mandatory instructions; up to includes zero.
Instead replaces preceding effects.
Can pretend fewer Elements consistently for whole Power, not cherry-pick individual thresholds.
Recheck Elements for later thresholds; completed effects do not change retroactively.
Speed/Range/target modifiers apply before relevant targeting; or branch selected before either branch resolved.
Draw four from chosen Minor/Major deck, reshuffle appropriate discard if needed, keep one to hand and discard rest to shared deck discard.
Each gained Major requires separate Forget from hand, personal discard or play, including new Major.
Forgotten Minor/Major goes to shared deck discard; Unique goes under Spirit panel and is unavailable normally.
Forget from play loses Elements and unused use immediately; already resolved effect continues.
Transfers/gifts and explicitly exempt take differ from gains; ordinary gain does not itself allow playing mid-turn.
Explicit extra card play bypasses normal track play allowance, follows effect payment, grants Elements immediately.
Newly played Power resolves at appropriate speed when not in middle of other action, unless explicit immediate resolution permission.

checked_claims.area: Damage, Health, Destroy, Remove and Replace
claims: Unspecified Damage is to Invaders; allocate among target Invaders freely; ordinary Damage may combine this turn.
Destroy at marked Damage reaching Health; Health and Damage are distinct.
Moving damaged piece out of Health bonus/into penalty destroys in destination.
Destroy returns to supply and generates building Fear; Remove/Replace do not inherently generate Fear.
Replacement retains damage and can then cause normal destruction.
Defend reduces each occurrence of Invader Damage to land and Dahan separately, stacks, and does not suppress Dahan counterattack.
Concealing Shadows only prevents Damage to Dahan from Ravaging Invaders, not land Damage, other Damage or explicit Destroy instructions.
Protected survivors counterattack.
source_refs: Printed Concealing Shadows face: 1 Fear; Dahan take no Damage from Ravaging Invaders this turn

claims: Gather into target and Push out of target from/to adjacent lands; pieces can use multiple origins/destinations.
Range boosts do not extend Gather/Push; numeric without up to mandatory to extent possible.
No normal off-island/Ocean movement; explicit exceptions can permit it.
Land is not adjacent to self but is Range 0 of self; unrestricted Move to same land counts.
Repeat grants another Power use, not card play or printed Elements; explicit Element-granting text works again.
Changes to Range/Speed retained; threshold Elements rechecked.
Ordinary Repeat uses most recently assigned speed; explicitly immediate Repeat follows explicit timing.
Specified Repeat location overrides normal origin/range/target restrictions; otherwise any legal target.
Ignore Repeat instructions on repeated Power; other text still works.
Powerstorm/Gift of Strength selection may wait until Repeat and can select card played later if still in play and meeting restrictions.
They repeat Power Cards, not Innates; Powerstorm permits up to three different cards.
Self-Range/Speed threshold modifications carry to Repeat even if no longer meeting threshold and do not stack twice.
Terror I no Invaders, II no Towns/Cities, III no Cities; earning final Fear card wins independent of card text.
Loss routes: Spirit absent from island, specified Blight depletion, need to Explore but no card.
Healthy depletion usually flips/refills rather than loses immediately.
Finish entire action tree before check; simultaneous win/loss is sacrifice victory; single-land Ravage including counterattack and triggers can win despite loss.
Do not resolve all other Ravages first; Terror divider applies immediately but outcome check at tree end.
Eight balanced lands per board, two of each terrain; adjacent across border/corner and boards.
Ocean normally not land/in play; only printed Ocean border makes Coastal; cliffs do not.
Your lands mean own Presence; Sacred Site normally at least two same-Spirit disks; sharing different Spirits does not make real Sacred Site.
Destroyed Presence off tracks; old Blight does not bar placement or destroy arriving Presence.
Active card/board supplies post-setup Blight.
Each addition to a land destroys one Presence per Spirit present.
If already Blighted, add one more to one adjacent land, repeating as necessary; original addition remains; counts do not multiply cascade.
Revisiting land can destroy Presence again; cascades remain part of originating action.
Flip immediately when pool insufficient for simultaneous required addition, retain old remainder in new pool, resolve immediate flip effects as nested actions, resume additions.
Remove Blight returns to current pool without healing Blighted side or Presence.
Global four-per-Spirit marker cycle, carry excess Fear; top Fear earned face-down.
Dividers update immediately; final card text need not resolve.
Earned cards resolve in earning order/current Terror only, no look-ahead; newly earned during Fear appended and resolved now, later earnings wait.
Each player completes instructions before next; no own Presence/Power Range restriction unless card specifies.
Generic Presence/Sacred Site requirements may be anyone’s; expressly own sites are individual.
Same piece may be moved/chosen repeatedly unless different choices required.
Only each instructions creates action per each; mixed global and each is one tree with nested each actions; single scaling Health removal totals allowance but separate players cannot pool.
One Spirit one board and one-player amounts; Another Spirit can self-target but conditional other-Spirit bonus does not apply.
One person with several Spirits fills multiple roles and does not gain single-Spirit solo targeting exception.
Numeric bonuses do not waive source/target requirements or one-of-your-lands wording.
General bonuses affect printed Range arrows in receiving Spirit’s own Powers, including internal effects, subject to restrictions.
Bonus does not increase another Range boost, including Reaching Grasp’s printed +2.
Own bonuses do not affect other Spirit’s Power merely targeting receiver; Power-only bonuses do not extend Growth.
Shadows of the Dahan modifies land-targeting Range box only, not effect-text arrows.
Land-targeting effect Range measured from target land unless otherwise stated.
Spirit-targeting effects measure from Presence of instructed Spirit unless otherwise stated.
Power user’s bonuses apply regardless of measurement origin; Blazing Renewal explicitly measures from user’s Presence.

checked_claims.area: Dynamic widespread effects and unusable Innates
claims: Single-land Power fixes contents when used; widespread effects check contents as relevant.
Dahan on their Guard counts Dahan when damage occurs; Encompassing Ward follows current Presence.
Innate merely modifying its own Speed/Range is insufficient for use/targeting.
source_refs: Printed Dahan on their Guard and Encompassing Ward faces

checked_claims.area: Triggered actions and Vengeance of the Dead
claims: After effects wait until originating action fully completes; no direct/indirect self-trigger.
Repeated Vengeance instances may trigger one another but cannot recur within own branch.
Corrected Vengeance text grants 3 Fear and after each destruction effect deals 1 Damage per destroyed Town/City/Dahan in target land.
source_refs: Printed Vengeance of the Dead face

claims: Dahan Raid/Enheartened Damage is total, not per Invader; updated Enheartened II/III each player different land, Gather up to two, then Damage with Dahan requirement.
Trade Suffers III Coastal restriction applies to either downgrade.
Overseas Trade Seem Safer II skips whole Coastal City Build and does not substitute Town; ordinary Town Build proceeds.
Scapegoats II/III one action per populated land with specified piece destruction.
source_refs: Printed Dahan Raid, Dahan Enheartened, Trade Suffers, Overseas Trade Seem Safer and Scapegoats faces

claims: Printed Call on Midnight’s Dream and Overseas Trade Seem Safer differ slightly from FAQ title aliases as stated.
Crops always generates 2 Fear before replacement or choice; Veil’s 1-Damage-per-Dahan assignments must hit different Invaders.
Unqualified +N Damage is additional total Damage at that step; damage boosts remain original source for destroyed counts.
source_refs: Printed Call on Midnight’s Dream, Overseas Trade Seem Safer, Crops Wither and Fade, Veil the Night’s Hunt, Blazing Renewal and Mists of Oblivion faces

claims: Song of Sanctity Slow despite missing cost-circle ink in affected printings.
Dissolve line3 Pushes all Explorers and its threshold Invader damage is simultaneous.
Poisoned Land threshold counts newly added Blight; Tsunami threshold Fear for each other affected Coastal land.
source_refs: Printed Song of Sanctity, Dissolve the Bonds of Kinship, Poisoned Land and Tsunami faces

claims: Wrap in Wings no Defend if zero Dahan move; same-land unrestricted Move may count.
Blazing Renewal no threshold Damage without any Presence restored; that land is restoration land.
Trees and Stones moves Defend2 per Dahan Pushed by its own threshold; later movement does not carry it.
Infinite Vitality prevents Damage/Destroy of Dahan, not Remove/Replace, and does not bar choosing land for Blight/cascade.
source_refs: Printed Wrap in Wings of Sunlight, Blazing Renewal, The Trees and Stones Speak of War and Infinite Vitality faces

claims: Sharing Presence only for targeting boxes, not text or your lands counts.
Joint disks may satisfy targeting Sacred Site but are not real shared site for Fear or effects; River’s rule belongs to River.
Solo gains two Powers and threshold 6 Energy; Major Forget requirements separate.
Transferred card can use special effect definitions, skip impossible personal-track instructions.
Chosen own land need not maximize instructions: Mantle and Tidal Boon can Push specified pieces without Town present.
Tidal Boon conditional only its own Push.
Spirit-targeting Fear without land specification has no land for Dread Apparitions.
source_refs: Printed Mantle of Dread, Tidal Boon and Dread Apparitions faces

claims: Lightning Fast conversion during Fast, one Power per current Air with previous uses counted; Innates eligible.
Harbingers Fear occurs in target land.
River’s Wetland site rule does not add disks and may choose actual one/two Presence for moving/affecting site.
Shadows pays 1 Energy at Power use, preserves other restrictions, carries modification to Repeat without new payment.
Shadows cannot skip first threshold while using second with same requirements; Gather first if able.
source_refs: Printed Harbingers of the Lightning face

claims: Choke is optional; Steady Regeneration Healthy/Blighted refers to card; regeneration can use destroyed Presence.
Green gained Power can inform mandatory placement.
Thunderspeaker accompanies generic Move as well as Gather/Push and can carry one Presence per Dahan.
Sworn to Victory after full single-land Ravage including cascade/counterattack, one Presence within Range1 per Dahan destroyed, irrespective of Blight.
Board with Ocean Presence treats Ocean as Coastal Wetland for Powers/Blight, not normal Growth/Fear/Invader actions.
Powers/Special Rules may measure through Ocean; Growth may measure from existing Ocean Presence.
Other Spirit Presence may legally arrive by Power, including Thunderspeaker accompanying Dahan.
Ocean’s Inland placement restriction remains unless explicitly ignored, with Indomitable Claim example.
Drown after humans move into Ocean on board with Ocean Presence, not necessarily Presence in Ocean; destroy, generate building Fear immediately, put Invaders on panel.
Exchange X printed Health for 1 Energy with X Spirits, ignore modifiers and make change; no Dahan Energy.
Ocean remains in play through tree if last Presence removed mid-action; then illegal non-human pieces out of play.
Failed Drowning Pushes humans to non-Ocean land in same action and grants no Energy; final illegal-state cleanup after tree before outcome is not movement/removal/destruction/action.
No legal cleanup destination means supply; normal watery destruction is not automatically Drown.
Explicit Power Damage/Destroy is hypothetical except own Presence; explicit Dahan Damage/Destroy skipped.
Per Power evaluate normal hypothetical outcome, 0/2/5 Fear, Push would-be-destroyed Explorer/Town; separate Powers/Repeats do not combine hypothetical damage but instructions within Power can.
Existing real Damage helps and is not healed; actual-destruction-dependent bonuses do not trigger.
Fear Cards/counterattack, Remove/Replace, real Blight, Invader actions and indirect reduced-Health destruction work as stated.
Bringer-pushed Town Drowned by Ocean produces total3 Fear; Spirits May Yet Dream may flip earned/deep-deck card.
This Power is Call on Midnight’s Dream, not new Major; using normal Major Forget on it also satisfies its conditional.
Forgotten card leaves play and cannot later be selected through normal once-this-turn Repeat permission.
source_refs: Printed Call on Midnight’s Dream face

claims: No important standard-core procedure found missing after complete source reads.
Explicit component delegation covers individual Spirit, Power, Fear and Blight instructions without claiming to reproduce every face.
Excluded adversary/scenario/thematic/optional-scoring/expansion rules in broad FAQ captures were not imported as playable modules or named examples.
Captured B&C-only Sky Stretches to Shore and Cast Down into the Briny Deep are not presented as core cards in candidate.
General timing, Range and illegal-state rulings have original-core application independently of broad FAQ product tags.
source_refs: Complete candidate and full CORE text/full Core and Setup FAQ
Raw B&C p6 legend, all33 printed faces, focused Range FAQ txt+HTML
